questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests a complex data path with tenancy, streaming, replay semantics, and backpressure. Probes data isolation, idempotency, and eventual consistency under failure modes.

## Key Concepts

- Data isolation across tenants
- Exactly-once or idempotent processing
- Replay/re-ingestion guarantees
- Backpressure and burst handling in streaming stacks
- End-to-end verification across warehouse and dashboards
